This notebook explores intensive longitudinal dyadic data, using the daily
diaries of the Time and Ties (T&T) study.

## Load the ILD data

```{r load-tt}
# One row per person and diary day. merge_data.Rmd in the dashboards
# repository creates the file; load() creates `df_merged`.
load("../../../00DashboardsTimeAndTies/Merged_Dataset_long.rda")
```

## MLM (glmmTMB) 

```{r}
library(dyadMLM)
library(glmmTMB)
library(dplyr)

df <- df_merged |>
  mutate(
    support = (
      daily_sp_support1 + daily_sp_support2 + daily_sp_support3) / 3, 
    gender = factor(baseline_gender_option, levels = c(1,2), labels = c('male', 'female'))
  ) |>
  dyadMLM::prepare_dyad_data(
    dyad = coupleID, 
    member = userID, 
    role = gender, 
    time = diaryday, 
    predictors = support, 
    keep_compositions = 'male-female',
    include_arbitrary_member_contrast = TRUE
  ) |> print()
  
```
